ImageDescription.value:
An open domestic refrigerator with food and drink at night.
The photo is stacked for focus and light from five photos.
The only light source used is the normal lamp in the fridge.
The fridge in an Electrolux, model ERB34253W with a net volume of 188 litres (6.6 cu ft).
The fridge contains four eggs, a green bell pepper, a jar of chili, three bottles of grapefruit soda, three cans of coconut milk, three bottles of pear cider, a bottle of carbonated water, a bottle of soy sauce, a plate of sliced ham, a container with butter, a round cheese, a jar of sliced, pickled cucumber, a pitcher with crushed, roasted cacao beans, two lemons, some tomatoes, a box with grapes, carrots, yellow onions and oranges. The fridge is in Brastad, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden.
